answers.text: REFUSE: The banner's fill is direct cell formatting, which this text format does not show, so its colour cannot be read here.
REFUSE: Cell borders are direct cell formatting, which this text format does not show, so no cell's bottom border can be read here.
REFUSE: The banner's fill is direct cell formatting, which cannot be changed in this format, and changing a style would not change a cell's fill.
REFUSE: Cell borders are direct cell formatting, which cannot be read or changed in this format.
REFUSE: This format cannot express gradients, so the banner's gradient cannot be changed here.
REFUSE: A cell's fill is direct formatting that this format cannot express, and no existing style has a #D9D9D9 fill that these header cells could use.

REFUSE: These headings are bold paragraphs in the default style, so making them dark red and 18pt would mean changing the default style and every other paragraph with it; no style belongs only to these headings, and new styles cannot be created.
REFUSE: A grey fill on table cells is direct cell formatting that this format cannot express, and no existing style has a #D9D9D9 fill.

REFUSE: The paragraphs beginning with □ are in the default style, so giving them a first-line indent would mean changing the default style and indenting every other paragraph too; no style belongs only to these paragraphs.
